purpose: 按照问题清单建立任务书，补全 P07 专业阶段应有的数据、角色、步骤、输出、验收与 handoff。

problem_list.name: K00/HER route recovery was initially missing or implicit
problem_list.required_closure: Keep route audit as mandatory acceptance field for P07 and future P08.

problem_list.name: Acceptance wording could confuse file readiness with route/system readiness
problem_list.required_closure: Use explicit status ladder; never READY_RUNTIME.

problem_list.name: P07 data objects exist as package design but not as executable runtime evaluator
problem_list.required_closure: Future runner/tool-binding stage must implement gate evaluators and P08 request generation.

problem_list.name: Professional decision data model needs exhaustive phase-step map and object ledger
problem_list.required_closure: Create professional completion taskbook, object ledger, role model, validation matrix, handoff requirements.

problem_list.name: P08 handoff remains design-only because P08 package/runtime is not yet built
problem_list.required_closure: Route next to P08_EXECUTION_RISK_CONTROLLER_PACKAGE_DESIGN via K00 before runtime/paper execution.

problem_list.name: Market thresholds, strategy weights, and human confirmation UI are not calibrated/integrated
problem_list.required_closure: Mark as P09/P10 calibration or Tool Binding work; not blocker for P07 package readiness.

problem_list.name: Any buy_signal/paper_runtime/live_execution output would violate P07 role
problem_list.required_closure: Keep hard negative rules forbidding direct runtime, signing, swap, broadcast.

completion_policy: 专业化包补全完成后，只能声明 package/design/control-plane readiness；不得声明 runtime ready、paper ready 或 live ready。
